author: Ryan George Extra Plus!
description:
Taking care of your health just got easier – start here with my sponsor Zocdoc: https://zocdoc.com/RyanPlus

Get exclusive videos & early access on my Patreon: http://patreon.com/RyanGeorge

I have some weird stories for you. Let's go.

The world's only hair museum has permanently closed its doors, which is both sad and a relief. A man in Australia planted his own armpit hair in his food to get out of a $600 restaurant bill, and he had done it before, which means he has a system. People on TikTok are churning butter while running, which is real and also raises several questions about when the milking stops. A man in the UK woke up with bright blue skin, was rushed to the hospital, and was fine — his friend Del gave him new bedsheets. And a man in British Columbia sent a family member to impersonate him at a mandatory ethics course, then lied about it, which is impressive in its own way.

These are the stories. I hope you are okay after hearing them.
